title: downpipe/0.1.0 cleartext bootstrap and decrypted shard-record shapes
description: Normative JSON shapes for downpipe/0.1.0, aligned field for field with SPEC.md. RootManifest is the cleartext bootstrap object stored at run/<runId>/root.manifest.json and serialised as RFC 8785 JCS (SPEC.md 5). ShardPreamble and ShardRecord are the per-line objects inside a decrypted shard manifest (after the downpipe-envelope unwrap, SPEC.md 6.1, 6.2); the shard payload is the downpipe STREAM (AES-256-GCM), never an age file. RunlogEntry is one line of _RECOVERY/RUNLOG (SPEC.md 10). RestoreReceipt is the machine-parseable receipt (SPEC.md 8.5). Binary-in-JSON is base64url no-pad (SPEC.md 11.4). Hashes and keyed-MAC outputs are bare lowercase hex SHA-384, 96 chars (SPEC.md 11.8). Recipient fingerprints carry the dpr1: prefix and signer fingerprints carry the edmldsa1: prefix (SPEC.md 7.6.1, 11.4); there is no age, x25519: or Bech32 recipient string in this major. Counts and sizes are a JSON number when at most 2^53-1 and a decimal string only when larger (SPEC.md 11.3). This schema cannot express the count canonical-form split, the byte-level container framing, the HKDF derivations, the recipient-set or break-glass byte binding, the RFC 8785 canonicalisation, or the codec-equality cross-field rule; those are normative only in SPEC.md and are enforced by the reader.

ulid.description: Canonical 26-char uppercase Crockford base32 ULID; I L O U excluded (SPEC.md 11.6).

rfc3339Utc.description: RFC 3339 UTC, literal Z, exactly three fractional digits (SPEC.md 11.5). Emission-canonical only; a reader makes no decision from a timestamp, so the regex does not range-check the instant.

hexSha384.description: Bare lowercase hex SHA-384 or HMAC-SHA-384, 96 chars (48 bytes), no prefix (SPEC.md 11.8). Used for content, plaintext, segment, shard, record, recipient-set and Merkle hashes and for the keyed-MAC outputs segId, keyNameHash and keyCommitment.

base64urlNoPad.description: base64url with no padding (Go RawURLEncoding), the only base64 variant in downpipe JSON (SPEC.md 11.4).

recipientFingerprint.description: Hybrid X25519 + ML-KEM-1024 recipient fingerprint: 'dpr1:' then lowercase hex SHA-384 over pk_X25519(32) || ek_MLKEM1024(1568) (SPEC.md 7.6.1).

signerFingerprint.description: Hybrid Ed25519 + ML-DSA-87 signer fingerprint hint: 'edmldsa1:' then lowercase hex SHA-384 over ed25519Pub(32) || mldsa87Pub(2592) (SPEC.md 11.4). A hint only, never a trust decision (SPEC.md 8.3).

uint53.description: An in-range count or size as a JSON number; MUST be at most 2^53-1. A value above this MUST be a decimal string (see countField). The string form is NOT permitted for an in-range value (SPEC.md 11.3).

countField.description: A count or size (SPEC.md 11.3). Canonical form: a JSON number when at most 2^53-1, a decimal string ONLY when larger. JSON Schema cannot express the threshold split, so this oneOf accepts either representation for in-range values; the reader MUST additionally reject the string form for any value at most 2^53-1 and reject a number above 2^53-1 (exit 6).

sourceType.description: The supported downpipe/0.1.0 source types (SPEC.md 12.1). kv, r2, secrets and d1 restore by a direct value write; workers, cf-config, stream, images and artifacts restore by re-provisioning or replay (their value is verified and surfaced, never blind re-applied). The reserved durable_object and vectorize are deliberately excluded: a reader refuses a sourceType outside this set (SPEC.md 12.1).

recordSalt.description: 16 random bytes, base64url no-pad (exactly 22 chars). Present ONLY on a secrets record, where it is fresh random; a non-secret record OMITS the field entirely, with no all-zero placeholder (SPEC.md 6.3).

envelope.description: Exactly six fields and no others (SPEC.md 5.2). keyCommitment and recipientSetHash are top-level, not nested here, and there is no secretsCompressionDisabled or any run-wide secrets-compression flag.

recipients.description: Recipient PUBLIC keys, inline in the signed root. Break-glass first, then operational when present. The default posture has 2 entries; the break-glass-only posture has 1 (SPEC.md 5.1, 5.2, 7.6).

masterCapsule.description: A BARE ARRAY of wraps, one per recipient in canonical recipient order (SPEC.md 5.4). NOT an enclosing object with a member array, NOT a base64url blob and NOT an age file. Each wrap's selector field is 'fingerprint', the same dpr1: value as the matching recipients[] entry.

recipientSetHash.description: Top-level field, NOT nested under envelope. SHA-384 over the sorted 1600-byte hybrid recipient encodings (SPEC.md 7.6.1).

keyCommitment.description: Top-level field, NOT nested under envelope. HMAC-SHA-384 over the recovered master (SPEC.md 8.4).

object.description: The stored shard-manifest path, the encrypted .dpe container (SPEC.md 5.1, 5.2). The wire form carries the full run-relative path run/<runId>/manifest/<shardId>.dpe.

namespace.description: Present only for a namespaced source such as KV (SPEC.md 6.2, 6.3).

bucket.description: Present only for a bucketed source such as R2 (SPEC.md 6.2, 6.3).

database.description: Identity annotation, emitted only on a d1 record: the D1 native database UUID this backup is OF (the record name carries only the binding name). Optional, omitted when empty; NOT an input to recordHash (SPEC.md 6.5).

account.description: Identity annotation, emitted only on an API-discovery record (workers, cf-config, stream, images, artifacts): the Cloudflare account this backup is OF. Optional, omitted when empty; NOT an input to recordHash (SPEC.md 6.5).

segments.description: Ordered, non-empty (SPEC.md 6.3). Every emitted record line is a present, readable record; there is no vanished record line in this format (SPEC.md 6.3, 12.5).

incompleteMarker.description: Present ONLY when this record's value is an incompleteness SENTINEL the writer emitted in place of real bytes; the value is the marker kind (the closed set the reference writer stamps). Absent on every real-data record and on every archive sealed before the field shipped. Sealed inside the shard manifest whose SHA-384 the signed root binds (tamper-evident), but NOT an input to recordHash (SPEC.md 6.5).

allOf.description: recordSalt is secrets-only: present for a secrets record, which MUST also have codec none (SPEC.md 6.3, 7.5, 12.4). Modelled with if/then, not in the base required list.

RunlogEntry.description: Exactly seven fields (SPEC.md 10). No recoveryBundle field; the bundle's integrity is anchored by its own SHA384SUMS (SPEC.md 9).

type.description: The restore sink the offline binary actually emits: 'file' (one file per record under --out), 'env' (dotenv lines), 'discard' (a restorability check that verifies and writes nothing), or 'verify' for a verify-only run (SPEC.md 8.5, 12.6). A Secrets Store / secrets-manager / S3 / stdout target needs the engine and is not a sink this offline tool writes, so it is not in this enum.
